sideEffects: the token's pending movement (stopMovement, in combat)
methods.doc: Stop a moving token as a click on it would: out of combat it is put where it is drawn; in a started combat the client that started the move stops it at the next square (stopMovement). A GM asks that client directly (the pentaryn-movement.stopOwn query: GM sender only), so a GM may stop any move; a player asks the active GM through this row's relay, which stops it only when it started the move and the sender owns the token (NOT_INITIATOR / NOT_OWNER otherwise). Stopping a member of a group this client sent stops the group and cancels its unsent waves. Never held back by the 400 ms arming a click waits for. NOT_MOVING when it is not moving or you cannot control it.
Live smoke checks after a sync: published, settings readable, the core methods wrapped (drag, keyboard, pathfinding, group drop, click to stop), hooks registered.

settings.doc: GM policy for player ghost movement: off, exploration (off while a combat runs on the scene) or always.
The mode the GM toolbar button restores when it is switched back on (exploration or always).
This player's ghost button (their wish); in effect only while the policy allows it. Client scope.
Draw this player's own tokens on top, on their screen only. Client scope.
Drag pathfinding around walls: everyone (default), gm (GM drags only) or off. Read live on every drag.
This client's drags find a path around walls (when the world setting allows it). Client scope.
Round a found path's corners into arcs where that stays clear of walls and costs no extra movement. Client scope.
Several tokens dragged together each walk their own route to their own spot, started in turn so they do not overlap (0.4.0).

The table's drag help (0.4.9): off, every drag is plain Foundry dragging (no pathfinding, no group plan, no single-drop routing); the GM's toolbar button flips it. Pathfinding and Group movement keep their own values.
Clicking a moving token stops it where it is (in combat, at the next square). Client scope (0.4.0).
